h2: Four steps. No phone tag. No back-channel.
s1Body: Objective, target audience, markets, budget range, dates. One form, ten minutes. Or paste the brief you already wrote.
s2Body: A buyer on our European desk works the brief across the catalog, requests live rates from publishers, and packages the options.
s3Body: Side-by-side options with firm prices, placements, dates and specs. You approve. One contract. One invoice per market.
